req.title: Task id is auto-generated
req.statement: The system shall assign a unique integer id to each new task; client-supplied ids in the payload shall be ignored.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-030 requires: (1) every POST /tasks/ response includes an auto-generated integer id, (2) consecutive tasks receive distinct ids, (3) any id supplied by the client in the request body is silently ignored and the server-assigned id is used instead. Tests cover: positive EP (normal create returns integer id), negative NEG (client-supplied id is ignored, not echoed), boundary BVA (two consecutive creates yield ids that differ by exactly 1), DT (id uniqueness across multiple creates), and STC (state: no task → task exists with server id). Mutation targets: == vs !=, integer type check, id increment logic, id-override suppression.

tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_create_task_returns_auto_generated_integer_id():
    payload = {"title": "Auto ID Test Task", "description": "checking auto id"}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body["id"], int)
    assert body["id"] == 21
    assert body["title"] == "Auto ID Test Task"
    assert body["completed"] == False
    assert "created_at" in body

POST /tasks/ with second task payload

tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_consecutive_tasks_receive_sequential_unique_ids():
    r1 = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "First Sequential Task"})
    assert r1.status_code == 201
    id1 = r1.json()["id"]
    assert id1 == 21
    r2 = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Second Sequential Task"})
    assert r2.status_code == 201
    id2 = r2.json()["id"]
    assert id2 == 22
    assert id2 - id1 == 1
    assert id1 != id2
    assert isinstance(id1, int)
    assert isinstance(id2, int)

tests.name: test_multiple_tasks_all_have_distinct_ids
actions: POST /tasks/ three times with different titles
Collect all returned ids
Assert all ids are unique and form a set of size 3
expected: All three ids are distinct integers
No id collides with pre-loaded ids 1-20
trace: R-TASK-030: system assigns a UNIQUE integer id to each new task
DT: decision table covering multiple simultaneous creates
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_multiple_tasks_all_have_distinct_ids():
    titles = ["Unique ID Task A", "Unique ID Task B", "Unique ID Task C"]
    ids = []
    for title in titles:
        r = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": title})
        assert r.status_code == 201
        ids.append(r.json()["id"])
    assert len(set(ids)) == 3
    assert set(ids) == {21, 22, 23}
    preloaded = set(range(1, 21))
    for assigned_id in ids:
        assert assigned_id not in preloaded

tests.name: test_created_task_retrievable_by_auto_generated_id
preconditions: No task with id 21 exists yet
actions: POST /tasks/ to create a new task
Capture auto-generated id from response
GET /tasks/{id} using the captured id
Assert retrieved task matches created task
expected: Retrieved task title matches submitted title
trace: R-TASK-030: auto-generated id must be valid and usable for retrieval
STC: state transition from non-existent to existing task via auto id
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_created_task_retrievable_by_auto_generated_id():
    payload = {"title": "STC Retrieval Task", "description": "state transition test"}
    r_create = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r_create.status_code == 201
    created = r_create.json()
    assigned_id = created["id"]
    assert assigned_id == 21
    r_get = client.get(f"/tasks/{assigned_id}")
    assert r_get.status_code == 200
    fetched = r_get.json()
    assert fetched["id"] == 21
    assert fetched["title"] == "STC Retrieval Task"
    assert fetched["completed"] == False
